summary: Stores recent time-history slices of input POP points, then optionally connects those slices into primitives. It can trail fixed point counts by adding a new dimension or match changing point counts by an Id-like attribute.

key_params.name: ageattr
key_params.note: Output Age attribute in seconds or frames

key_params.name: attrname
key_params.note: Attribute name used to match changing point identities

key_params.name: uintmax
key_params.note: Maximum unsigned integer value for match attributes

key_params.name: maxls
key_params.note: Maximum line strips allocated for trailed output

key_params.name: surftype
key_params.note: Output primitive type for connected trails

key_concepts: Trail POP records recent input point slices over time and can output those history slices as points or connected primitives.
Stable point counts can be trailed by dimension, while changing point counts need Attribute Match with a stable identity attribute.
Length and increment units control temporal sampling, while surface, closed, max line strip, and transform controls shape the generated trail geometry.
common_gotchas: Changing point counts require a stable match attribute such as particle Id; otherwise trail connectivity cannot follow identity.
Use seconds for trail length when moving components between projects with different frame rates.
maxls must be high enough when creating line strips from matched point histories.
